## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=gemini-2.5-flash sha=14f8b2215454)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 3 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 0 / MINOR 1 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 3; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MINOR | The `SharedKeyAuth.Authorize` method's logic for canonicalizing the `Content-Length` header is highly complex and sensitive to Azure's specific rules, increasing the risk of subtle bugs if the specification changes or is misinterpreted. While tested, its intricacy makes it a potential point of failure. | ACTIONED | Actioned and verified in go/azurestore and go/edpsvc test suites. |
| 2 | NIT | The `Put` method explicitly sets the `Content-Length` header in the request headers map, which is redundant when providing a `bytes.NewReader` as the request body, as `http.Request` automatically infers the length in such cases. This is harmless but adds unnecessary code. | ACTIONED | Actioned and verified in go/azurestore and go/edpsvc test suites. |
| 3 | NIT | [OUT_OF_SCOPE] The changes in `product-forge/go/edpsvc/internal/auth/tenant_auth.go` and `product-forge/go/edpsvc/internal/limits/middleware_test.go` are minor whitespace/alignment adjustments unrelated to the Azure Blob adapter. | ACTIONED | Actioned and verified in go/azurestore and go/edpsvc test suites. |
